preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) >= 2 and all(c in '()[]' for c in s) for s in test_case_strings)
preconditions.description: Each test case string s contains only '(', ')', '[', ']' and has length at least 2.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(q, int) and 1 <= q <= 200000 for q in test_case_queries)
preconditions.description: The number of queries q for each test case is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l < r <= len(s) and (r - l + 1) % 2 == 0 for s, queries in zip(test_case_strings, test_case_query_lists) for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: For every query (l, r), 1 <= l < r <= n, and the substring length (r - l + 1) is even.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(s) for s in test_case_strings) <= 1000000 and sum(q for q in test_case_queries) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of string lengths across all test cases does not exceed 10^6, and the sum of queries does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == sum(q for q in test_case_queries)
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per query across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) >= 0 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.

postconditions.expression: all(min_cost(s, l, r) == int(output_lines[idx]) for idx, (s, queries) in enumerate(zip(test_case_strings, test_case_query_lists)) for i, (l, r) in enumerate(queries) for idx in [sum(q for q in test_case_queries[:i]) + i])
postconditions.description: For each query (l, r) on string s, the output value equals the minimum cost to transform the substring s[l-1:r] into a correct bracket sequence using the allowed operations.
